clips.title: The story
paras: At Stormwind's gates, Lieutenant Orrin watches for Scourge incursions and calls for scouts. The Argent Dawn officer stands in the Valley of Heroes, where he directs recruits to investigate undead threats beyond the capital.

Lieutenant Orrin watches the road from the Valley of Heroes. The Argent Dawn is known for holding the front lines in the ruined north, but it also guards strongholds farther south, including Stormwind City. When necromantic magic stirs beyond the capital, Orrin sounds the alarm and rallies adventurers before the undead can threaten the people within.

Lieutenant Orrin connects the Argent Dawn with volunteers in the southern kingdom. When signs of the Scourge appear beyond Stormwind's gates, he sends scouts to gather intelligence and secure hazardous artifacts. Cracked necrotic crystals are among the objects they recover, helping the order understand and repel the undead threat.
